name: zlanqing/office-academic-skill
description: A collection of academic skills (24 SKILL.md files confirmed, including research-writing-skill and scientific-toolkit-skill) for academic Word and PowerPoint workflows, research writing, and presentation writing. Tailored for Chinese language workflows.
install: copy skill folders to ~/.claude/skills (for example cp -r claude-academic-skills/research-writing-skill ~/.claude/skills/), plus a plugin install line. Note: the README install examples use a placeholder username, so use the real repo path, not the placeholder verbatim.
